verses.text: Ha Yespíritu Jehová Kajalil ayoch t'ayin, yujto sik'b'il in el yuj. Chekb'il in kot yuj, yik tzul walel wach' ab'ix t'a heb' meb'a', swak'an stek'anil heb' manhxa yip yuj kusk'olal, swalan t'a heb' icha preso yaji to syal yel heb' t'a libre.
Swalanpaxeli to ix ja sk'ual ko kolchaj yuj Jehová ko Diosal, sk'ual pax yak'anek' ko pak t'a heb' kajk'o'ol. Ix in chekjikoti yik swak'an sniwanil sk'ol heb' kusk'olal yaji.

Tzin jawipax wak' tzalajk'olal t'a heb' aj Sion kusk'olal yaji, haton heb' syak'k'e k'e'en tik'ak'il ta'anh t'a sjolom, a tzalajk'olal swak' sk'exulok ok'el. Ha b'it yik aloj wach' lolonel swak'kanoch sk'exulok ilk'olal. Lajan ol aj heb' icha junok te' ji awab'il yuj Jehová, yik sb'eyb'alej tojolal heb' yuj yik'ancha'anh Jehová chi' heb'.
Ha juntzanh chonhab' satnakeli, ol sb'oxik'e heb', ol sb'oanpaxk'e juntzanh pat heb' mak'b'ilem lanhnaj t'a peka'.
Ex wetchonhab', a heb' ch'ok nacional ol tanhwan nok' he kalnel, he munlajel yet' eyawb'en uwa.
Ol yalan heb' to sacerdote ex Jehová, schekab' ex ko Diosal. Ol ex tzalaj yet' sb'eyumal juntzanhxo nación chi'. Wach' ol aj eyilji yuj tastak wach' yilji ol yak' heb' t'ayex.
Ha ex tik, icha wal ix aj eyab'an sya'il, k'ixwelal yet' b'uchwal, icha pax chi' ol aj he cha'an he b'eyumal yet' he tzalajk'olal, malaj slajwub'.

Yujto a wal tojolal snib'ej Jehová, skot yowal yuj elk'al yet' ixtoj anima. Yuj chi' wal t'a smojal ol aj spakan t'a heb' ix ex ixtani. Ol lajwok chi', ol sb'o'an jun strato heyet'ok t'a masanil tiempo.
Ol b'inaj wal eyinhtilal t'a skal masanil chonhab'. Masanil mach ol ex ilanok, ol nachajel yuj heb' to a Jehová tz'ak'an swach'k'olal t'ayex.

Tzin te tzalaj wal tiknaik yuj Jehová, tzin k'e wal cha'anh in tzalaj yuj in Diosal, yujto te wach' ix yutej yak'an in kolnab'il yet' tojolal, ichato ix och in pichulok yuj. Icha swach'il tz'ajoch spichul junok winh kelem yet' junok ix kob'es ayik snupnaj heb', icha chi' in yutej.
Icha tz'aj sk'eul tas sk'ib' t'a sat lu'um, ma icha yelta swol junok te te', icha chi' ol aj yak'an cheklaj tojolal Jehová Kajal t'a yichanh masanil nación yuj yik'jicha'anh.
